summary_en: 6,000 shares (0.7% of shares outstanding), ¥9.70M aggregate. ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block executed 2026-07-14 at reference price ¥1,617/share. Settlement same day. Results to be disclosed after market close.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares through off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: CCN Group Corporation's board of directors on 2026-07-13 authorized purchase of 6,000 treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3) on Tokyo Pro Market. Execution scheduled for 2026-07-14 at 08:45 JST at the reference price of ¥1,617 per share, for a total outlay of ¥9,702,000. The purchase order is valid only for that specific trading session; results will be disclosed after market close. The company stated the purpose is to enable flexible future capital allocation from the perspective of enhancing corporate value. As of 2026-07-13, shares outstanding (excluding treasury) numbered 906,000 shares, with 23,500 shares then held in treasury.
